newsitem.title: USA: Shelby Williams optimistic about Q2 growth.
newsitem.headline: Shelby Williams optimistic about Q2 growth.

text.p: Shelby Williams Industries Inc said Wednesday it is optimistic about its prospects for additional sales and earnings growth in the second quarter.

Earlier, it reported a 24.1 percent rise in net income for the first quarter to $2.2 million or $0.25 a share from $1.7 million or $0.20 a share a year ago. Sales rose to $41.8 million from $40.7 million, which included $2.3 million in sales of divested divisions.

"Given the strength of our backlog, as well as continued strong hotel refurbishing and new hotel construction activity, we are optimistic about our prospects for additional top- and bottom-line growth in the second quarter," said Paul Steinfeld, chairman and chief executive.

"Much of the growth in sales and backlog came from refurbishing activity," Steinfeld said, adding the company also received two "significant" orders for new construction of the Chicago Beach Hotel in Dubai and the Adam's Mark Hotel in Dallas.
Shelby Williams manufactures contract seating for the restaurant, lodging, healthcare, and university and college markets.
